overview:
NewtonX is an AI-driven B2B research company founded in 2016 by former McKinsey consultants Germain Chastel and Sascha Eder, along with CTO Anuja Ketan. Headquartered in New York City, NewtonX differentiates itself from traditional expert networks by combining AI-powered expert sourcing with rigorous verification, enabling clients to access insights from a pool of over 1.1 billion professionals across 140 industries. The company's proprietary Knowledge Graph — a machine-learning-powered multi-query search engine — dynamically identifies and engages hard-to-reach niche experts, while a two-step verification process ensures 100% of respondents are qualified.

NewtonX occupies a unique position at the intersection of expert networks, market research, and AI-driven analytics. Unlike traditional expert networks that rely on fixed databases, NewtonX custom-recruits experts for each project, supporting methodologies ranging from 10-person virtual panels to 10,000-person quantitative surveys, as well as qualitative interviews and AI-moderated research. The company serves Fortune 500 enterprises, top management consulting firms, and financial institutions, with named clients including Microsoft, Salesforce, Pinterest, TikTok, and The Wall Street Journal.

NewtonX has raised $47 million in venture funding through its Series B round and generated approximately $38.5 million in revenue as of 2023. The company has expanded its capabilities with synthetic data (NXAD), AI-moderated interviews, and the NewtonX Hub platform. Its designation as the official B2B research partner for the 2024 GRIT Business & Innovation Report underscores its growing industry credibility.

history.narrative: NewtonX was founded in 2016 by Germain Chastel (CEO) and Sascha Eder (COO), both former McKinsey consultants, alongside CTO Anuja Ketan. Chastel, a Harvard Business School graduate and former McKinsey partner, envisioned leveraging AI to create the best on-demand B2B knowledge access platform. The company raised a $3M seed round in 2018 followed by a $12M Series A in 2019 led by Two Sigma Ventures. Tragically, co-founder Germain Chastel passed away unexpectedly in April 2021 at age 36. Sascha Eder assumed leadership, and the company closed a $32M Series B later that year. Under Eder's continued leadership, NewtonX has expanded into AI-moderated research, synthetic data, and the NewtonX Hub platform.

servicesDetailed.name: Quantitative B2B Surveys
servicesDetailed.description: Large-scale survey research targeting precise B2B audiences. NewtonX custom-recruits respondents via the Knowledge Graph rather than relying on standing panels, ensuring 100% verified participants. Supports market sizing, competitive intelligence, pricing research, and brand perception studies.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Interviews
servicesDetailed.description: Qualitative one-on-one interviews with verified subject matter experts. NewtonX handles end-to-end logistics including research design, expert recruitment, recording, transcription, and translation. Experts are sourced on-demand for each project.

servicesDetailed.name: AI-Moderated Research
servicesDetailed.description: Automated expert interviews that deliver qualitative insights at survey-like scale. AI moderation reduces costs and accelerates speed-to-insight, gathering rich open-ended data from hundreds of respondents in days rather than weeks.

servicesDetailed.name: NewtonX Augmented Data (NXAD)
servicesDetailed.description: AI-driven synthetic data that uses verified B2B responses to generate augmented samples, boosting the size and feasibility of research for hard-to-reach niche segments while maintaining data integrity.

servicesDetailed.name: NewtonX Prime (Investment Research)
servicesDetailed.description: Expert intelligence solution providing investors and analysts with access to NewtonX's database of expert surveys and transcripts across sectors including tech and healthcare, replacing time-consuming expert calls with on-demand intelligence at scale.

servicesDetailed.name: Custom Research & Consulting
servicesDetailed.description: End-to-end research engagements including design, data collection, analysis, and reporting. Deliverables range from raw data exports and executive summaries to expert analysis. Supports long-term arrangements and multi-wave studies.

aiPlatform.narrative: NewtonX's technology stack is anchored by its proprietary Knowledge Graph, an AI/ML-powered multi-query search engine launched in 2021 that can identify professionals from a pool of over 1.1 billion across 140 industries. Unlike traditional expert networks that maintain fixed databases, the Knowledge Graph dynamically searches structured and unstructured data sources to locate exact experts for any question, then engages them through AI-generated personalized outreach. Every professional undergoes a two-step verification covering identity and subject matter expertise. Beyond sourcing, NewtonX uses AI across its workflow: AI-moderated interviews automate qualitative collection at quantitative scale, the NXAD engine extends sample feasibility for niche segments, and the Hub platform centralizes recruitment, fieldwork, and analysis.

complianceExtended.narrative: NewtonX maintains one of the most robust compliance frameworks in the B2B research industry. The company is SOC 2 certified with annual third-party security audits, GDPR compliant, and participates in the BBB Data Privacy Framework. On the research ethics side, NewtonX is a member of ESOMAR, the Insights Association, and the Market Research Society (MRS). AI-powered compliance monitoring proactively scans expert interactions for restricted or non-public information. The Trust Center provides transparency into security controls including penetration testing, incident response planning, and cybersecurity insurance.

complianceExtended.regulatoryContext: NewtonX operates in the B2B research and expert network space, requiring careful handling of potentially material non-public information (MNPI), particularly for investment research clients using NewtonX Prime. AI-powered compliance monitoring and 100% verification mitigate MNPI risks. SOC 2 certification, GDPR compliance, and BBB DPF participation address data security and privacy across jurisdictions. Clean regulatory record with no reported enforcement actions.

clientFit.narrative: NewtonX is best suited for organizations needing high-quality, verified B2B insights at scale — particularly those conducting quantitative surveys targeting hard-to-reach professional audiences. The AI-driven custom recruitment model makes it especially valuable for clients who have struggled with traditional panel quality or need to reach niche decision-makers. Pricing and methodology are optimized for survey-driven and mixed-method research rather than ad-hoc one-off expert calls.
